name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: A two-state theme toggle that switches immediately between light and dark mode.

files.content:
<script is:inline>
  // A stored "dark" or "light" is the visitor's choice. Without one, such as
  // no value or "system", the theme follows the system.
  const getStoredTheme = () => {
    if (typeof localStorage === "undefined") return null
    const theme = localStorage.getItem("theme")
    return theme === "dark" || theme === "light" ? theme : null
  }

  const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")

  const getThemePreference = () =>
    getStoredTheme() ?? (media.matches ? "dark" : "light")

  const disableTransitionsTemporarily = () => {
    const style = document.createElement("style")

    style.appendChild(
      document.createTextNode(
        "*, *::before, *::after { transition: none !important; }"
      )
    )

    document.head.appendChild(style)

    return () => {
      void document.documentElement.offsetHeight

      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        style.remove()
      })
    }
  }

  // The theme this provider applied last. A class change to another theme
  // comes from outside, such as a toggle without the provider, and is saved
  // as the visitor's choice.
  let appliedTheme

  const applyTheme = (theme, disableTransitions = false) => {
    const restoreTransitions = disableTransitions
      ? disableTransitionsTemporarily()
      : null

    appliedTheme = theme
    document.documentElement.classList[theme === "dark" ? "add" : "remove"](
      "dark"
    )

    restoreTransitions?.()
  }

  // "dark" or "light" saves a choice; "system" follows the system again.
  window.__setTheme = (theme) => {
    if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined")
      localStorage.setItem("theme", theme)
    applyTheme(getThemePreference(), true)
  }

  applyTheme(getThemePreference())

  // Follow the system while there is no choice, and a choice made in
  // another window or frame of the site.
  media.addEventListener("change", () => {
    if (!getStoredTheme()) applyTheme(getThemePreference(), true)
  })
  window.addEventListener("storage", (event) => {
    if (event.storageArea !== localStorage) return
    if (event.key === "theme" || event.key === null)
      applyTheme(getThemePreference(), true)
  })

  // Astro's <ClientRouter /> replaces the <html> attributes with those of the
  // next page, which cannot know the theme. Carry the theme over before the
  // swap, so it neither flashes nor reaches the observer below as a choice.
  document.addEventListener("astro:before-swap", (event) => {
    const swap = event.swap
    event.swap = function (...args) {
      event.newDocument.documentElement.classList.toggle(
        "dark",
        appliedTheme === "dark"
      )
      return swap.apply(this, args)
    }
  })

  if (typeof localStorage !== "undefined") {
    const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
      const theme = document.documentElement.classList.contains("dark")
        ? "dark"
        : "light"
      if (theme === appliedTheme) return
      appliedTheme = theme
      localStorage.setItem("theme", theme)
    })

    observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
      attributes: true,
      attributeFilter: ["class"],
    })
  }
</script>

export { default as ThemeToggle } from "./theme-toggle.astro"
export { default as ThemeProvider } from "./theme-provider.astro"
